title: Scraper: Supermicro AMD (EPYC + TR-Pro M12SWA)
description:

Goal: Scraper for Supermicro AMD-platform motherboards. Single most valuable server-vendor scraper — Supermicro publishes complete BIOS history per board on a structured catalog page (no auth, no WAF). Covers EPYC SP3/SP5/SP6 plus the TR-Pro M12SWA-TF / M13SWA WRX80/WRX90 boards.

board_class: EPYC (primary), ThreadripperPro (M12SWA, M13SWA family).

Sockets: SP3 (H11), SP3/SP5 (H12), SP5/SP6 (H13), sWRX8 (M12SWA-TF), sWRX9 (M13SWA-TF).

Access strategy:
- Catalog: https://www.supermicro.com/support/resources/bios_ipmi.php?vendor=2 (vendor=2 = AMD). Confirmed during survey to list every AMD MBD-* model in H11/H12/H13/M12/M13 lines (28+ models verified).
- Per-board download page: https://www.supermicro.com/en/support/resources/downloadcenter/firmware/{MODEL}/BIOS — tabular history of all BIOS versions with direct ZIP links.
- No bot-protection observed on these endpoints. Plain User-Agent works.

Implementation notes:
- list_boards: GET catalog page, parse model anchors (H11SSL_BIOS, H12SSW-AN6_BIOS, M12SWA-TF_BIOS, etc.). Strip _BIOS suffix to recover MBD model. Map H11→SP3/zen1-2, H12→SP3/SP5, H13→SP5/SP6, M12SWA→sWRX8, M13SWA→sWRX9 by series prefix.
- list_bios_updates: GET per-board BIOS page, parse table rows for version, release date, ZIP URL. Supermicro keeps full history (including beta and revoked) in the page — capture release_date from the table.
- download: Plain ZIP from the CDN, contents typically include {model}.B{version} raw binary alongside a flash utility. Skip *.exe/*.bat/*.txt; pick the largest file matching the board model prefix.

License-safe references:
- BooterMicro (MIT, https://github.com/zylon-internet/BooterMicro) — Perl prior art that parses supermicro.nl/support/bios. Approach is a reasonable cross-check; do not import code (Perl, GPL FreeDOS components in the larger repo).
- smc_updater (no license) — reference only for the page selectors; do NOT copy code, no license = all rights reserved.

Acceptance criteria:
- AsusScraper-shaped class committed at src/psp_etl/scrape/supermicro.py
- Tests: parse a fixture catalog page and a fixture per-board BIOS page; URL-pattern parser; fixture ZIP extraction
- ingest.classify_board_class returns EPYC for SP3/SP5/SP6 and ThreadripperPro for sWRX8/sWRX9 boards (already wired)
- CLI registration in src/psp_etl/cli.py:_VENDOR_SCRAPERS

Related: #79 (survey), #81 (EPYC parent).
